summary.text: Bridget Moore is a Democratic state representative who has represented Missouri House District 93 since January 2021 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Bridget Moore graduated from Ursuline Academy in St. Louis in 2006 and earned a degree from the Bradley University Institute of International Studies in 2010.
In the 2025-2026 session, Moore was the ranking minority member of the Local Government Committee and also served on the Conservation and Natural Resources Committee.
